about: Cost verdict for each Document 3 resource card, confirmed by the owner on 2026-10-21. 'basis' is the card's own wording the verdict rests on; the build fails if that wording no longer appears on the card, so a reworded card forces a fresh decision. A card missing here shows no sticker.

saylor-academy-prdv226-introduction-to-h.basis: free certificate of completion (no application, no fee; pass their exam at ≥70%)

saylor-academy-bus301-human-resource-man.basis: free, including the final exam and certificate (≥70%)

the-open-university-openlearn-human-reso.basis: free Statement of Participation when you create a free OpenLearn account

openlearn-three-more-hr-courses-same-pro.basis: free to study, free Statement of Participation on completion

cipd-the-free-factsheet-hub.basis: free (some items ask for a free CIPD account; a subset is members-only)

alison-the-hr-and-talent-acquisition-cou.basis: the printed diploma/certificate sits behind a paid "Certify Now" package

itcilo-free-self-guided-courses-from-the.basis: A digital credential is issued once you complete the required activities

greenhouse-learn.basis: free on-demand training and recorded sessions; no paid licence needed to learn the product

cipm-nigeria-free-nigerian-labour-law-st.basis: free, published by the institute itself

shrm-free-toolkits-and-templates-us-fram.basis: toolkits and templates are free downloads

linkedin-jobs-free-tier-is-enough.basis: You do not need Premium to apply
